JD




We are seeking a highly skilled Generative AI Lead/Engineer to design, develop, and deploy enterprise-grade AI solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI frameworks, and cloud AI platforms. The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, architects, and development teams to deliver innovative AI-driven solutions.

Generative AI Development

Design and implement Generative AI applications using OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Llama, and other LLMs.
Build conversational AI solutions, AI assistants, chatbots, and document intelligence systems.
Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using vector databases.
Fine-tune and optimize foundation models for domain-specific use cases.
